name: Columns Match-3 for M5StickC Plus2
author: coreymillia + GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Classic Sega Columns match-3 puzzle game with 5 colorblind-friendly colors, ghost piece preview, 400ms lock delay, and all-direction matching. Features smooth 3% progressive difficulty and chain reaction scoring.
features: ✨ Match-3 in All Directions (horizontal, vertical, diagonal)
📈 Progressive Difficulty (3% speed increase per level)
🎯 Smooth Controls with Lock Delay Reset on Movement

gameplay.objective: Match 3 or more gems of the same color in any direction
gameplay.gem_cycling: Rotate colors within the column (not piece orientation)
gameplay.matching: Horizontal, vertical, and both diagonal directions
gameplay.chain_reactions: Gems fall after matches, creating new combos
gameplay.game_over: When new piece can't spawn at top

palette: White - White block with black dot + X
Green - Green block with black X
ghost_markers: White ghost gems have white dot
Green ghost gems have white X
colors.reasoning: High contrast colors with unique visual markers to distinguish white and green

mechanics.lock_delay: 400ms delay before piece locks when landing
mechanics.ghost_piece: Colored outline shows exact landing position

match_detection.multi_direction: One match can trigger multiple directions simultaneously

requirements: Mini Joy C Hat (REQUIRED for gameplay)

installation.note: Single file contains bootloader, partitions, and firmware

usage_instructions: 1. Connect Mini Joy C hat to M5StickC Plus2
2. Flash firmware using M5Burner with MERGED.bin
4. Use joystick button or BtnA to cycle gem colors
6. Ghost piece shows where it will land
7. Match 3+ gems in any direction for points
9. Press BtnB for instant hard drop
10. Game over when top is blocked - press any button to restart
tips_and_strategies: Use lock delay to slide pieces into tight spots
Watch ghost piece for perfect placement
Set up chain reactions for higher scores
Moving horizontally resets lock delay timer
Plan ahead - next pieces spawn randomly
Diagonal matches are just as valuable
Green X and white dot help quick identification
Ghost markers match real piece patterns
Level up every 1000 points for faster speed
Maximum speed at level 20 is very challenging

differences_from_tetris.rotation_mechanic: Cycle gem colors inside column (not orientation)
differences_from_tetris.line_clearing: Match 3+ colors in any direction (not full rows)
differences_from_tetris.gravity: Individual gems fall after matches (not whole pieces)
differences_from_tetris.scoring: Match-based with chain multipliers (not line count)

version_history.1.0.0: Initial release: Full Columns gameplay with ghost piece, lock delay, 5-color palette, chain reactions, progressive difficulty
